intro: Meet your new favourite home essential—Harmony. Designed for modern living, it’s the perfect balance of elegance and everyday functionality, making your space more organised and inviting.

features.title: Your timeless walnut finish
features.text: The rich walnut finish with a matte touch adds warmth and sophistication to your space, blending seamlessly with modern or classic interiors.

features.title: More than just a side table
features.text: Designed for versatility, it doubles as a nightstand, side table, or additional storage—serving various purposes in different spaces effortlessly.

features.title: Compact and Functional Design
features.text: Its space-efficient structure makes it ideal for smaller rooms while offering ample functionality, from storing essentials to displaying décor.

features.title: Built to last, styled to impress
features.text: Crafted with 18mm prelaminated particle board, it ensures lasting strength and resilience for daily use, without compromising on style.

features.title: Simple setup, instant transformation
features.text: Quick and straightforward to assemble, it lets you enhance your room without the hassle, making home improvement enjoyable.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
